info.title: Backend API
info.description: Auto-generated API documentation for Parse Server backend

post.summary: Create AI summary for a lecture
Sync multiple offline-logged procedures in one request
Supervisor co-signs a procedure live at the point of care (Flow 1, BLE or QR)

get.summary: Preview who/what a scanned co-sign code refers to, before the supervisor taps

put.summary: Supervisor confirms or rejects an async procedure (Flow 2/3)

get.summary: List procedures awaiting the current supervisor (co-sign + confirmation)
List procedures with optional filters (status, reliability level, anomaly flag)
Verify the append-only hash chain of procedure records (tamper detection)
Detect suspicious student–supervisor collusion / rubber-stamp patterns
Export a student report as PDF
Count a student's procedures grouped by procedure type
Anonymized comparison of a student against the cohort

post.summary: Submit student answers for an assessment

post.description: Authenticate a user with username and password and return session token

200.description: Login successful with user data and session token

post.description: Invalidate the current user session and log out

get.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated user with their roles

questions.description: Array of MCQ questions. Each item: { question: string, choices: string[], correctAnswerIndex: number }

withTest.description: Whether the lecture has a test/assessment

assessment.description: Associated test/assessment if withTest is true

Announcement.description: Official announcements and news published by administrators

targetGroup.description: Target group code (e.g. first year, second year)

CoSignSession.description: Short-lived secret linking a procedure to a live supervisor co-sign (BLE or QR)

code.description: The secret code exchanged phone-to-phone (BLE service data or QR)

student.description: The student who logged the procedure

supervisor.description: The named supervisor, if the student chose one

expiresAt.description: When the code stops being valid

used.description: Whether the code has already been consumed (single-use)

Complaint.description: Student complaints visible only to administrators

Hospital.description: Hospital where clinical procedures are performed

ProcedureType.description: Types of medical procedures that can be logged

Procedure.description: Medical procedures logged by students and reviewed by supervisors

procedureDate.description: Date when the procedure was performed

reviewedAt.description: Date when the procedure was reviewed

isOffline.description: Whether the procedure was logged offline

loggedAt.description: Server clock at submission (unfakeable). Compared against procedureDate.

entryGapMinutes.description: Minutes between claimed procedureDate and server loggedAt

reliabilityScore.description: Reliability score 0..10 computed from the trust signals

assuranceLevel.description: Assurance level derived from the reliability score and signals

reliabilitySignals.description: Per-signal breakdown of how the reliability score was computed

reliabilityFlags.description: Anomaly flags raised for admin review (e.g. BULK_ENTRY, BACKDATED)

recordHash.description: SHA-256 of this record + prevHash (append-only integrity chain)

prevHash.description: recordHash of the previous procedure in this student's chain

liveCoSign.description: Supervisor co-signed live at the point of care (Flow 1)

proximityVerified.description: Supervisor's phone was verified near the student's phone (BLE)

bodyPhoto.description: A non-identifying patient body photo is attached

coSignStatus.description: State of the live supervisor co-sign handshake

coSignExpiresAt.description: Deadline for the live co-sign before it lapses to async confirmation

proximityEvidence.description: BLE proximity evidence from the co-sign (rssi/distance/method)

confirmationStatus.description: State of the asynchronous supervisor confirmation

confirmationDeadline.description: Deadline for the supervisor to confirm before the tier is lowered

isEmergency.description: Logged as an emergency (no supervisor present); confirmed on-call

isRead.description: Whether the notification has been read

channel.description: Target channel/topic for group notifications (e.g. year_1, all)

OfflineProcedure.description: Deprecated - offline procedures are now synced directly to Procedure table via syncOfflineProcedures

user.description: User who logged the procedure offline

syncedAt.description: Date when data was synced to server

ResearchPaper.description: Academic research papers shared by students

authors.description: List of authors of the research paper

answers.description: Array of selected answer indexes, one per question. e.g. [0, 2, 1]

is_api_user.description: Whether user is an API user

fcmToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging token for push notifications

UserHospital.description: Links users to hospitals they are assigned to

restApiKey.name: X-Parse-REST-API-Key
restApiKey.description: REST API key for client requests
